title: Beacon Signalboard: route & I/O-mode latency explorer (p50/p95/p99)
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Add a new observability dashboard (Beacon Signalboard) that surfaces per-model and per-route latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) with explicit breakdowns for streaming vs non-streaming I/O modes. The board should make it easy for SREs and runtime engineers to identify regressions tied to request shape, interplay with KV caching, and trace-error correlations. We will wire tracing hooks to correlate high tail latency traces to specific serve paths and expose synthetic vs real-traffic cohorts.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows p50/p95/p99 for every model-route pair and supports filtering by deployment (hosted/dedicated/private)
I/O-mode toggle that splits metrics into streaming and non-streaming series and preserves percentiles across both groups
Each percentile point links to the top 25 traces (sampled) that contributed to the tail with trace IDs and error counts
Metrics are sourced from Prometheus histograms (or derived SLO summaries) and align within 2% of existing route-level SLI snapshots
Logs and traces for a selected time window are queryable from the panel with pre-filled correlation_id and request_shape filters
Alert rules for p99 by route are prototyped (notify on sustained p99 > X ms for >N minutes) and reviewed by SRE
implementation_notes: We'll create a new Grafana board (Beacon Signalboard). Backend work: expose per-route histogram metrics with io_mode label (streaming|blocking), ensure trace sampling is bumped to 10% for routes with recent regressions, and add a short-lived 'tail-sampler' triggered by p99 spikes to capture full traces. Frontend: implement route table, timepicker, cohort selector (synthetic vs real), and trace drilldown links to Jaeger/Zipkin. Coordinate with infra for retention considerations and with cost team for sampling budget.
telemetry_sources: prometheus: /metrics (route_latency_histogram_seconds with labels: model, route, io_mode, env)
jaeger: tracing hooks will add span tag 'serve.path' and 'io.mode' and include request_shape and correlation_id
vector/kafka logs: structured request logs with latency_ms, http_status, model, route, kv_cache_hit
sli-aggregator: per-minute SLI rollups for dashboard quick rendering
dashboards_to_create: Beacon Signalboard: per-model-route latency percentiles + io_mode split
Beacon Detail: trace-linked tail table with top contributing spans and error signatures
tracing_hooks_changes: Add 'serve.path' and 'io.mode' tags to top-level request spans; attach correlation_id to all downstream spans; add a tail-sampler that triggers on p99 breach to capture full KV-cache state span annotations. Ensure hooks are no-op when traces are disabled and respect sampling configuration per-tenant.
log_pipeline_changes: Update Vector pipeline to enrich logs with model, route and io_mode fields earlier in ingestion. Add a lightweight dedupe processor for tail-samples and route-based partitioning to avoid hot shards in Kafka. Ensure logs forwarded to long-term storage include correlation_id and trace_id.
alerting: Escalation: if p99 > 1200ms for 15m raise page to oncall and open investigation checklist
Noise control: suppress alerts during scheduled deploy windows and when canary flag is active
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): wire metrics and create dashboard for a single high-traffic route (conversations.generate) and verify percentiles against existing SLI dashboards
Phase 2: expand io_mode labeling across top 20 routes and enable tail-sampler (limited to 1% of traffic initially)
Phase 3: open dashboard to SREs and product teams, iterate on filters/columns based on feedback
Phase 4: promote sampling & instrumentation changes to all routes and add automated alerting
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: increased tracing/storage cost from higher sampling -> Mitigation: tail-sampler is rate-limited and auto-disabled after budget threshold
Risk: label cardinality explosion from request_shape -> Mitigation: bucket shapes into canonical bins and record hashed examples separately for debug
Risk: dashboard performance if querying raw histograms -> Mitigation: add aggregated SLI rollups and precompute summary tables for UI queries
testing_and_validation: Unit tests for histogram export and io_mode labeling
Integration tests: end-to-end test that a synthetic streaming request shows up in streaming series and trace link resolves
Load test: simulate 50k rps across mixed io modes and confirm dashboard renders within 3s and p99 calculation matches ground-truth samples
Runbook walkthrough with SRE to validate alert thresholds and remediation steps
notes: Design ask: prioritize a compact route table view with sparklines for p50/p95/p99 and a single-click trace drilldown. Aim for low-cardinality labels on the main panel; expose advanced filters in a collapsible side panel. Coordinate with Console UX to prototype in 2 days.
next_steps: Create Prometheus metric PR to add io_mode label and histogram buckets
Implement tracing hook change in runtime and open PR
Build dashboard skeleton and demo to SRE by 2026-03-12
